name: input-password-strength
title: Password with strength meter
description: Password with strength meter. Core/Input pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/Input and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system.
